sections.title: Steps at the market
sections.content: A visit to the market has steps. Greet the seller, ask the price, say what you want, ask for the total, pay. In the order, pick the verb by the object: for any one, an amount or a bare noun, use *kérek* (*Egy kilót kérek.*); for a particular one, use *kérem* (*Ezt kérem.* *A körtét kérem.*).

sections.title: What to say
rows: Take the one you point at

items.spanish: Jó napot! Mennyibe kerül a paradicsom?
items.english: Good day! How much do the tomatoes cost?
How much is that in total?

sections.content: Before you say *kérek* or *kérem*, check the object. *Egy*, a number or no article means *kérek*. *A / az*, *ezt* or *azt* means *kérem*.
